verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a fintech and payments platform, not an AI agent or assistant host. Plugging external MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this product type. Its AI features (Spend AI receipt matching, the Kai onboarding assistant) are built-in automations, and the evidence shows no MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
